mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ is the presumption that Acts are in conformity with the Constitution.
An important form is the presumption that Acts are in conformity with the Constitution.
Fill in the blank: ______ refer to different parts of speech of an expression and are presumed to have the same meaning throughout the enactment in which they appear.
Cognate expressions refer to different parts of speech of an expression and are presumed to have the same meaning throughout the enactment in which they appear.

Fill in the blank: ______ is the existence of a state of emergency; but in some cases the general power is granted to enact inconsistent legislation by special procedures (which we looked at in Module 2 Unit 1).

The principal justification allowed is the existence of a state of emergency; but in some cases the general power is granted to enact inconsistent legislation by special procedures (which we looked at in Module 2 Unit 1).
Fill in the blank: ______ is concerned with the governance of Nigeria.
Legislative drafting is concerned with the governance of Nigeria.
fib: ______ is a deliberate device to secure checks and balances between state authorities and to allow for specialization of functions.
The division of powers is a deliberate device to secure checks and balances between state authorities and to allow for specialization of functions.
______ is a party to multilateral treaties negotiated under the UN and to a regional treaty administered by a regional institution (ECOWAS).
Nigeria is a party to multilateral treaties negotiated under the UN and to a regional treaty administered by a regional institution (ECOWAS).
______ is an aspect of the professional responsibility of the drafter to safeguard the statute book.
Providing this advice is an aspect of the professional responsibility of the drafter to safeguard the statute book.
______ is responsible for permitting conduct that is inconsistent with the Bill of Rights.
The Legislature is responsible for permitting conduct that is inconsistent with the Bill of Rights.
